06/04/2024
First notice of loss received from the insured driver reporting a side impact at a signalized intersection, with the
claimant seated in the front passenger position. The claimant is represented by counsel, and all further contact is
being routed through the attorney's office.
06/11/2024
Confirmed the driver is named on the ploicy and that coverage was in force at the time of the reported loss. No issues
with the policy temrs have been identified so far.
08/06/2024
Obtained the police report, which places the claimant in the vehicle at the scene and records the same sequence of
events the insured described. The responding officer noted the impact point consistent with a vehicle entering the
intersection from the side.
08/16/2024
Reviewed scene photographs and statements from two independent witnesses, who both describe the collision as
occurring just as the insured reported it. The other driver's statement matches on the sequence and location.
09/07/2024
Inspected both vehicles. The damage pattern on the insured vehicle lines up with the reported side impact, and the
repair estiamte reflects damage consistnet with that force. No prior damage to the vehicle has come to light in the
records or photos reviewed.
10/07/2024
Rceeived the claimant's medical records through counsel. The reported knee injury fits the type and force of the
crash, and the treating physician documented findings in line with that mechanism.
11/09/2024
Treatment followed a typical course, with physical therapy and follow-up visits. Notes show steady improvement, and
the frequency of visits tapered as the claimant recovered.
11/11/2024
Prior records show a minor strain to the same knee area several years ago, which resolved completely with
conservative care and has no bearing on the current complaint according to the treating physician's notes.
11/23/2024
The claimant's account of the accident has remained the same across the recorded statement, the medical intake
history, and conversations with counsel. Nothing in the file suggests the damage or injury predates the coverage
period.
12/08/2024
Reviewed the file with the claims supervisor, who agreed that the liability facts, vehilce damage, and medical course
are all consistent with the reported loss. No further investigation steps are needed at this time.
12/13/2024
Settlement discussions with counsel are proceeding on the basis of the documented medical treatment and property
damage. File remains open pending receipt of the final billing and the demand package.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
